workshop.title: Anthropic Workshop
workshop.description:
A workshop designed for developers, engineers and technical founders.

On the agenda

* Applied AI masterclass: how to build with Claude and agents
* Guided build: one build, waymarked to meet you at your level, from first agent to production patterns
workshop.notes: You must have a ServerlessDays ticket to book this workshop. You will be emailed a link to book the workshop after purchasing a ticket.

session.prerequisites: Please bring your laptop for the hands-on workshop.
